reviewed_by: Codex: exact-artifact restricted-profile source and runtime applicability review
limitations: Scoped to fixed typed OpenAI/OpenRouter operations and these exact Linux ARM64/AMD64 images; not a general clean scan or patched-component claim.
Requires UID10001, zero capabilities, no-new-privileges, read-only root, private local state, fixed owned children and allowlisted isolated egress.
Trusted authored builds and original private gateway backups only; arbitrary SQLite databases/native code/archives/SDK plugins/training and owner/root/host compromise are outside this assessment.
Secondary libc memory-layout mitigation weaknesses must be reassessed if any reachable memory-corruption prerequisite is identified.
New findings, changed artifacts/source/deployment or expired review fail admission; prefer reviewed fixed artifacts when available.
Paid approval and consumer/live acceptance are separate; no paid inference is authorized by this security assessment.
AMD64 local image execution used emulation; native AMD64 CI source-equivalent checks are recorded separately and do not share timestamp-dependent image identity.
